evals.name: create-from-scan
evals.setup: A Go CLI repo with no README: `go.mod` declaring `github.com/acme/portcheck`, `cmd/portcheck/main.go` wiring three flags (`-timeout`, `-json`, `-concurrency`), `internal/scan/` holding the logic, a `.github/workflows/ci.yml`, and `assets/logo.png`. `.editorconfig` sets `[*.md] max_line_length = 100`. Nothing states who the tool is for or why it exists.
evals.query: /readme-smith write a README for this project

evals.name: improve-member-readme
evals.setup: A multi-package Go repo whose root `README.md` carries the badges and the Packages table. `pkg/store/README.md` is a member README that carries its own badges row, a `## License` section repeating the MIT text, two code fences with no language, a nav line whose `#usage` anchor points at a heading that was renamed, and a `## Contributing` section duplicating `CONTRIBUTING.md`.

evals.name: gomake-example-injection
evals.setup: A Go library repo that uses gomake: its CI workflow runs a gomake step and `gomake --list` lists the built-in `:doc:mce` target. No README yet. The package has exported `New`, `(*Client).Do`, and `Parse`, and no `_test.go` files carrying `Example…` functions.
